content.text:
The thumb no longer covers the track's border: the thin line beside the list now runs the full height of the track, and the thumb sits just inside it. All 196 tests pass (1 ignored), the build has no warnings, and `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` pass. I haven't looked at it on a real screen.

**What was wrong:** when the thumb lost its own borders, it still spanned the whole column width. I had also cut the track's line wherever the thumb was, so the thumb looked like it broke through the border.

**What changed:**
- **Code (`src/scrollbar.rs`):** the thumb and the dark track around it start one pixel in, right of the line, which is now drawn from one button to the other. Hover and drag detection use the same thumb area.
- **Spec:** the Scrollbar scope now says the thumb fills the track inside its line and never covers it. It no longer says the thumb fills the column's full width.
- **New test (`thumb_keeps_inside_the_track_line`):** it checks that the line runs the full height of the track and nothing is drawn over it. With the old full-width thumb it fails, so it catches the problem you saw.

I read "default sizing" as the thumb fitting inside the track's borders. If you meant gpui-kit's own scrollbar style, a narrower thumb with a gap on each side and rounded ends, say so and I'll switch to that.
